#!/bin/sh
set -eu
root="$HOME/.local/share/ji-host"
printf 'CURRENT=%s\n' "$(readlink "$root/current")"
pid=$(systemctl --user show ji-host.service -p ExecMainPID --value)
printf 'PID=%s\n' "$pid"
tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$pid/cmdline"
printf '\nLOCATOR='
tr '\n' ',' < "$root/run/host-locator"
printf '\nCORE_SHA='
sha256sum "$root/current/lib/ji-host-core-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar"
printf 'PROTOCOL_SHA='
sha256sum "$root/current/lib/ji-host-protocol-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar"
